thread:
marta: FYI: EU telemetry ingest has a late window from 2025-06-11T03:00Z to 06:00Z. kicked a recompute but it saturated the replay coordinator and we hit per-shard GPU caps. looking for quick routing/quota mitigation before customer-facing dashboards degrade.
kenji: saw it on the cost/latency dashboard. can we route these replays to the low-priority lane + shard_fanout to avoid Dedicated hot pools? that should avoid impacting interactive requests.
jordan: low-priority + shard_fanout makes sense. tradeoff = longer end-to-end. we have some SLO slack on aggregate freshness so it's acceptable. also want incremental checkpointing so we can pause/resume without reprocessing from t0.
tara: also noticing many of the late-lines are duplicates from the mobile batching bug. can we dedupe by orig_ingest_id during replay to cut work?
sre-bot: alert: replay-coordinator EU shard=12 cpu=92% queue_depth=847 backfill_jobs=13
kenji: proposed temp route change (will push hotfix if green):
```
route: "telemetry-replay"
match: {region: "eu", job_type: "backfill"}
action: {lane: "low-priority", concurrency_limit: 4, shard_aware: true}
```
This keeps jobs in replay system but off the hot path.
hao: for dedupe we need coordinator to accept dedupe_key (orig_ingest_id or session_id+chunk_ts). if job metadata includes dedupe_key the coordinator can filter duplicate messages before scheduling heavy GPU tasks. requires small proto + index.
devex-sam: console note: Backfill Jobs page shows job progress but not per-shard queue metrics. can we add columns: remaining_messages, current_lane, dedupe_rate? i can wire UI up to /internal/replay/queues if the API exposes them.
kenji: replay coordinator already exposes /internal/replay/queues but only basic counts. i'll add lane and dedupe_stats to the response.
marta: quick plan: 1) kenji pushes routing hotfix to low-priority lane + shard_aware (short-term) 2) hao implements dedupe_key handling in coordinator (medium-term) 3) devex-sam adds minimal columns to console (ui feature-flagged) 4) infra/cli adds checkpointing flag for backfill jobs. estimates? need mitigation <3h.
kenji: ack, hotfix + rolling restart in ~30-50m, will monitor queue depth and coordinator load.
hao: ack, dedupe_key proto + db index ~6h work (tests + migration). can do follow-up backfill to enable opt-in dedupe.
devex-sam: ack, UI column behind feature flag in ~2h, will link a quick wireframe.
tara: ack, will run dedupe dry-run against snapshot in ~80m and post false-positive stats.
kenji: deploying route hotfix now. logs:
```
INFO replay-coordinator: applying route telemetry-replay -> low-priority
INFO scheduling: shard_aware enabled for region=eu
INFO routing: concurrency_limit=4 applied to backfill jobs
```
jordan: after route change shard 12 queue_depth dropped 847 -> 220 in 20m. coordinator cpu usage down ~40%. looks promising.
tara: dedupe dry-run results: ~24% of late events flagged as duplicates when using orig_ingest_id, mostly from same session_id+batch_ts. very low FP rate (~0.2%).
marta: great. marking incident mitigated for now. follow-ups: hao implement dedupe_key + index, kenji expose dedupe_stats in /internal/replay/queues, devex-sam add console columns, infra to add --checkpointable flag to backfill CLI so ops can resume partially completed jobs. will open follow-up tickets and add to runbook. thanks all :thumbsup:
